data.title: Neo-Brutalism
data.tagline: Use direct structure, strong contrast, and deliberately exposed construction
data.description: Neo-brutalist web design uses heavy outlines, bold type, simple shapes, hard shadows, and obvious interaction. It can feel energetic and candid when the hierarchy remains disciplined. Random misalignment and aggressive color do not become a design system just because they look unconventional.

use: A product with a direct, playful voice
Small sites that benefit from strong identity
avoid: Use constant visual shouting in a dense work tool
Sacrifice reading and focus states for attitude
Mix many unrelated colors, borders, and shadows
Imitate roughness without a consistent layout

data.agentPrompt: Neo-brutalist creator dashboard, clear income and order hierarchy, 2–3px black borders, hard offset shadows with no blur, yellow base with limited pink and blue status accents, extreme 800/400 type-weight contrast
